items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Al Hurt, Julian Lane, Al's brother, Slick Hurt, and Johnny Ronica, myself.

ctx.x: Al Hurt, Julian Lane, Al's brother, Slick Hurt, and Johnny Ronica, myself. Who else? Steve Jarrett Tanner played tenor, and Fazola, four saxes. Al Hurt and who else now? Wimpy Miller, Wimp is a lawyer you know.
